limits: No1000K pump, bearing, motor, materialstrength or bladecapture is experimentallyvalidatedbythispacket.
Commercial capture values are a transparent performance target atpreservedmolecularspeedratio; their actualhotperformance requires moving-walltransport.
A useful coldoutlet requires thermaltranspiration/reversefluxaccounting, not merely a volume-flow ratio.
Forelinepartialpressure must be maintained independently of directcatcher pulsepressure.
Motor/bearingidleloss, hotstatorclearance, radiationbaffletransmission and contamination protection are substantive apparatus requirements.
The current aperture/mass calculations do not claim a posteriorprobability distribution; no evidence-backed80% credibleinterval for the completehotpump is available.
